Body.Content:
Application change analysis was launched to provide a centralized view and analysis of changes at different layers of a web app. A lot of features have since been added. To help you scale, you now have the ability to turn on application change analysis at an App Services plan level—you no longer need to enable application change analysis for individual web apps. We’ve also broadened our support—you can now see resource manager changes for any resource. There are richer diagnostics for common scenarios such as virtual machines (VMs) + virtual network, SQL server, and storage. We added impact analysis so you can see what could be the downstream impact of  a change to a port or a file. Improvements have also been made to the UI, including a new set of defaults and better filters to help you eliminate noise.

We continue to iterate on your feedback and suggestions so keep them coming.

Learn more about application change analysis.
